name: Major cyber incidents
summary: Attacks on refrigeration controls at European supermarkets under investigation; no group has claimed them
state: Attackers altered internet-exposed refrigeration controls at supermarkets in several European countries from 2 Nov, forcing stores to discard food (BleepingComputer). Belgium's federal prosecutor has opened an investigation (Brussels Times), and no group had claimed the attacks as of 8 Nov. No national-scale outage of power, health or finance systems had been reported.
for_you: Follow NCSC guidance on securing internet-connected devices; consumers face little direct risk beyond store disruption.
rubric_hit: Attack disrupting large companies across countries = Watch
